name: Mice
prompt: There are droppings under the sink and a gnawed bag in the cupboard.

outcome.told: You leave a message about the mice.
outcome.line: {you} told the landlord about mice in the flat.

failure.told: Nobody comes. You hear them in the walls at night.
failure.line: {you} lived with mice that the landlord never dealt with.

choices.text: Buy traps and seal the gaps

outcome.told: You fill the gaps behind the pipes with steel wool and set the traps.
outcome.line: {you} set traps for mice in the flat.
